title: clickunder result.listing array with multiple destinations

source.name: Kadam Feed and RTB contracts, including in-page and clickunder examples
source.notes: All source records are retained in assets/sources.json by reference.sourceIds.

modifications: All IDs, domains, prices, timestamps, creative text and URLs independently authored.
Required visitor addresses use TEST-NET 192.0.2.44; required user IDs are clearly synthetic. No real subscriber data or feed credentials.
Media URLs use reserved .test hosts and require interception from fixtureAssets.
provenance.sanitized: No real visitor or subscriber data. IP 192.0.2.44 is TEST-NET-1; user IDs/feed keys are synthetic-fixture strings; all executable URLs use reserved .test hostnames and require local interception.

pairApplicability.note: Independently constructed offline pair preserving documented field names and carrier. Reserved endpoint replaces the vendor hostname; no live request or bid was made. Vendor zone/feed selection is fixture metadata where absent from body.

specNotes: Request format=cu explicitly chooses clickunder; response listing cardinality does not exceed limit.
Expose destination(s) as inert URL text. This response provides navigation, not embedded visual creative; do not count a preview of the URL as rendered landing-page creative.
Browser preview must not open real popups or dispatch tracking.
The documented vendor ad type must be identified in the merged format result. Public Core vocabulary uses pops for pop traffic. This is a vendor capability expectation, not an invented IAB extension.
notes: Core observations in the source archive were deliberately excluded from expectations. Protocol metadata may describe a vendor-specific 2.x carrier; it does not claim a normative minor-version inference.

knownGap.note: Documented response creatives retain their wire wrappers; a visible card or inert destination should be available, or absence reported as an unsupported preview capability.
